expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.hiukkanen==='protoni' && S.v===1 && Math.abs(S.B-0.2)<1e-9 && S.suunta==='ulos' && S.E===0 && S.running===false && S.valmis===false ? 1 : 0 })()

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return R.length===3 && Number(R[0].min)===0.5 && Number(R[0].max)===2 && Number(R[0].step)===0.1 && Number(R[1].min)===0 && Number(R[1].max)===0.4 && Number(R[1].step)===0.01 && R[2].min==='0' && R[2].max==='300' && R[2].step==='5' ? 1 : 0 })()

expr: (() => { const L=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select')].map(s=>[...s.options].map(o=>o.value).join(',')); return L.length===3 && L[0]==='protoni,deuteroni,alfa,vetyioni' && L[1]==='ulos,sisaan' && L[2]==='0.5,1,2' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: selects: particle, field direction, speed

expr: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); return b[0]==='Laukaise' && k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: main button first; DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
